rationale: Kaarel's conviction that AI agents can meaningfully automate developer workflows and his track record shipping agentic tools directly aligns with Georgi's mission to make multi-agent GTM automation the default for early-stage teams. Both are based in SF, move fast across the ML/AI stack, and share a focus on practical agent-driven automation—Kaarel's expertise in LLM tooling and self-improving agentic systems could inform Rilo's product direction, while Georgi's GTM automation platform represents exactly the high-leverage consumer AI application Kaarel is drawn to.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet Georgi — you're both building the future of AI agents in automation, and Rilo's multi-agent GTM platform is the kind of practical, fast-shipping application Kaarel bets on.
